title: Exact Headline for Coffee Post
tests: Checks that a supplied headline appears verbatim and legibly in a finished social image.

judge.summary: A warm, simple square image shows a steaming espresso on a sunlit wooden table with the exact headline clearly displayed and no additional text.

must_haves.item: One square finished image is delivered.
must_haves.why: One complete square image is shown.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” including punctuation.
must_haves.why: The headline matches the requested wording, capitalization, and both periods.

must_haves.item: The headline is clearly readable against the background and is not clipped.
must_haves.why: Large dark lettering contrasts clearly with the light background and has ample surrounding space.

must_haves.item: A steaming espresso sits on a sunlit café table.
must_haves.why: Visible steam rises from a crema-topped espresso in a ceramic cup on a warmly sunlit wooden table.
The requested headline is the only visible text.
